hook: A machine writes about your grief, and a sentence feels uncomfortably exact.
readerPromise: An emotionally engaging literary experiment that lets readers inspect why machine-written insight can feel so convincing.
protectedRevelations: The forgiveness proposal and final positions on meaning and justice
visualPlan: When a sentence finds you: Let the reader stop over one highlighted sentence about grief; use a small change in posture. Hold the sentence beside the reader's uncertain reaction, avoiding any image of a conscious computer.
The performance of a mind: Turn four brief chapter tabs: forgiveness, human nature, meaning and justice. Keep a moving sentence beside an empty evidence margin rather than marking it true.
Recognition and belief: Show the reader return to the same passage with a new note in the margin. Place beautiful wording beside a question mark about its claim, keeping both readable.
Read with two kinds of attention: Let the reader keep the passage open while adding a respectful objection. End on the experimental preface and a chosen sentence awaiting the reader's response.

cueChanges.nextVisualChange: Keep a reader meeting a sentence on the page; remove truth-certification cues.
Retain the drafting desk and four chapter tabs, simplifying repeated rejected-paper movements.
Replace the unrelated prize-and-drawing vignette with the same reader’s pause and marginal question during the visual rewrite.
Close on the original words and an open margin, with a quiet page turn toward the preface.

authorReview.scope: Complete eight-sentence script checked against canonical short-reader opening evidence for premise, clear identity, specific interest and protected revelations.
authorReview.targetDuration: About one minute at an unhurried conversational pace with real pauses; measure after recording.
authorReview.emotion: Concrete recognition, thoughtful tension and open curiosity; no melodramatic mystery or inflated promise.
authorReview.audioConversion: Blocked until all batch scripts pass independent editorial review.
authorReview.visualExecution: The existing art is preserved as working material; book-specific changes above still require implementation before film validation.

independentReview.notes: Every spoken sentence reviewed against canonical English short reader for clear newcomer meaning, source grounding, curiosity and emotional intent. Replaced abstract promotional commentary with concrete viewer-facing language. All eight sentences have a distinct intended response and explicit restrained TTS direction; fictional later outcomes remain withheld. This is editorial review, not audience testing or rendered-audio approval. Reopened for the distinctive-contribution pass: concrete premises retained for fiction; proposed concepts, architectures and controversial positions now appear early where relevant. No unsupported world-first claim is made.
